question: Which of the following characteristics is typical of the reverse myotatic reflex ?:

options.opb: The response of the homonymous muscle is a reflex contraction.
options.opc: The triggering receptor is the muscle spindle.
options.opd: The response of the homonymous muscle is a reflex relaxation.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Muscle spindle detects stretch in muscle -> Sensory neuron activated -> Signal sent to spinal cord -> Monosynaptic reflex arc -> Homonymous muscle contracts -> The response of the homonymous muscle is a reflex contraction -> 95%

CHAIN: Muscle spindle activated -> Sensory neuron stimulated -> Signal transmitted to spinal cord -> Excitation of alpha motor neuron -> Homonymous muscle contracts -> The response of the homonymous muscle is a reflex contraction -> 90%
